content_of_post_to_comment:
Discipline is a will power tool, no matter how much planning you do, at the end of the day it is about how much will power you have when the time comes to do the right thing.

A few months back I read the book psycho cybernetics, and i was intrigued whether it really works or not. [spoiler alert: it does]

I tried applying some psycho cybernetics principle in my life as an experiment to see how effective it is.

Today after 3 months i can say, its actually a legit thing. i have been able to adopt habit of working on my side hustle and quitting smoking using this, and the process was very effortless compared to the other changes i did in my life relying solely on discipline and will power.

I would want to share this method with anyone who wants to try this in their lives as well:

- Identify your raw goals

- Make them tangible

- Identify the Self-Image qualities you need to have, if these raw goals is something that you do naturally.

- use psycho cybernetics theatre of mind exercise to train your mind for these qualities (this is the only part of this method which requires daily will power and discipline 30 minutes everyday, but very fun to do once you see it work)

- Weekly analyse the behaviours which are preventing you from doing your goals and then identifying the limiting self image which are causing these behaviors

- Add the opposite qualities of the limiting self image to your psycho cybernetics installation process and continue the loop.

For anyone who want to change their self, or work on themselves this is something which is a must try.
comment: The self-image angle is something I’ve seen overlooked in habit change. Trying to force a behavior while still seeing yourself as “someone who doesn’t do that” creates a constant fight. I’m curious how long it took before the new identity started feeling automatic rather than like you were consciously practicing it.
